run_inpaint_pipeline: run the GaudiStableDiffusionInpaintPipeline to inpaint masked regions of an image using a text prompt on HPU
split_inputs_into_batches: split latents, prompt embeddings, mask, and masked image latents into batches for HPU batched inference
run_unet_hpu: run the UNet forward pass on HPU using either HPU graph capture-replay or standard inference
capture_replay_hpu_graph: capture a UNet computation graph on HPU, cache it, and replay with new inputs for faster inference
initialize_inpaint_pipeline: initialize a GaudiStableDiffusionInpaintPipeline with VAE, text encoder, UNet, scheduler, and HPU graph settings
